title: Layout
description: auto follows the page's shape: wider than 2:1 lays out as a band (strip beside the readouts, for the top or bottom edge), otherwise as a column (strip above a 2×2 readout grid, for corners). Size the page in your host; type and graphics scale with it.

title: Alignment
description: Which side the readouts sit on in the band layout (right puts them on the screen-edge side when the band hugs the right), and the corner the status line uses.

title: Backing
description: none: numbers and the strip float on the game, with a soft ground only under the strip. scrim: a soft dark wash across the box that fades out at its edges, for very bright maps. panel: the solid graphite panel.

title: Highlight colour
description: map: the live catcher and dash light take the current map's tonal accent (derived from its background, never shown). 18-lab: always amber. Heat colours are fixed.

title: Heatmap bins
description: How many columns the 0–512 playfield is split into. Fewer bins read as broad zones, more show fine positioning. Changes apply to the whole attempt instantly.

title: Colour intensity
description: Brightness curve of the heat colours, 0.25–4. 1 is linear; higher values lift rarely visited zones, lower values keep only the hottest spots bright. Bar heights stay linear.

title: Show catcher marker
description: Draw the live catcher (true catch range for the map's CS, filled while dashing) and its position line during play.

title: Show on results
description: Keep the finished attempt's heatmap on the results screen; osu! never shows where the catcher spent its time. Off: the overlay is empty on results.
